children: Vancouver, British Columbia – TheNewswire - September 3rd, 2026 - Canadian Uranium Corp. (CSE: CANU) (the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has completed its MobileMT survey of the King South project located on the Eastern side of the Athabasca Basin.

The King South Uranium project had a total of 696 line-kilometres flown across the property in an east-west direction as part of the Company’s ongoing uranium exploration program. Data from the survey is expected to be available within the next few weeks, after which a detailed interpretation will be developed to identify potential drill targets.

“The completion of the MobileMT data set is an exciting first step forward in the exploration of the King South property. This high resolution survey will allow the company to examine deep structures, at depth, where significant new discoveries such as Patterson Lake South and The Arrow deposit were made.” As stated by Geoff Balderson CFO

Born in Canada. Built for the World. Unlocking tomorrow’s clean energy. The Company’s strategy centers on assembling highly skilled technical teams with expertise in uranium geology, advanced geophysics, and northern exploration logistics. Through disciplined acquisitions, innovative exploration methodologies, and strategic partnerships, the Company aims to accelerate project advancement and unlock value across its exploration portfolio.
Canadian Uranium Corp., Geoff Balderson, Chief Financial Officer 604-602-0001gb@corporateminds.ca
